# Use fluffylabs bot to create PRs

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Use our GH app to create Pull Requests instead of the default Github Actions token.
This should actually run all of the workflows correctly.

## Walkthrough

This PR updates two GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/release-bump-version.yml and .github/workflows/vectors-update.yml). Both add a "Generate GitHub App Token" step using actions/create-github-app-token@v1 (inputs: app-id and private-key) and change the "Create Pull Request" step to use the generated token (steps.app-token.outputs.token) instead of secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN. The release workflow additionally removes `draft: true`, updates the Create Pull Request action version (v5 → v7), and simplifies the PR body heading and note content.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

- Homogeneous configuration edits across two workflow files.
- Pay attention to:
  - Correct secret/variable names for `app-id` and `private-key`.
  - Consistency of the step id `app-token` and its usage `steps.app-token.outputs.token`.
  - Updated action version for `actions/create-pull-request` and any input changes.
  - Intent behind removing `draft: true` and PR body text changes.
